newsitem.title: UK: SocGen and Ladenburg in Ukraine investment fund.
newsitem.headline: SocGen and Ladenburg in Ukraine investment fund.

text.p: Societe Generale Emerging Europe Asset Management (SGEEAM) and Ladenburg Thalmann International said Thursday they have launched a fund to invest in Ukraine.
The fund is seeking to raise a minimum of $50 million, but is likely to raise as much as $70 million, according to Richard Harding, managing director of SGEEAM.
"We believe the fund can offer exposure to Ukraine at an early stage in its development while it remains largely unknown by international investors," Harding said.
The fund will primarily make private equity investments, targeting the consumer goods sector.

"Privatisation is changing the face of Ukrainian business. The fund aims to support managers with a western-style outlook and plans for rapid growth in the businesses, especially in the consumer goods market," Harding said.
